Class OfferCardTrack

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.board.OfferCardTrack
public class OfferCardTrack extends Object
Represents the offer track made by offer cards on the game board.

This class manages the available OfferCard slots and the placement of players' totems during the place totem phase. It maintains the cards in a specific order (typically alphabetical) to resolve the turn progression correctly.

  • Constructor Details

    • OfferCardTrack

      public OfferCardTrack(Map<Character, OfferCard> track)
      Creates a new OfferCardTrack using the provided map of offer cards.
      Parameters:
      track - a map linking each card's letter identifier to its OfferCard instance. It must be a TreeMap (or similar sorted map) to guarantee the correct evaluation order of the cards.

      public OfferCard findTrackPosition(Player player)

    • toSnapshot

      public OfferTrackSnapshot toSnapshot()
      Creates a snapshot of the current state of the offer track for network synchronization.
      Returns:
      an OfferTrackSnapshot containing the mapping between card identifiers and the nicknames of the players occupying them

    • fromSnapshot

      public static OfferCardTrack fromSnapshot(OfferTrackSnapshot snapshot, int numPlayers, List<Player> players)
      Recreates the OfferCardTrack state from a network snapshot and the base game data. This method is primarily used for server persistency and restoring a game state.
      Parameters:
      snapshot - the serialized state containing the saved totem positions
      numPlayers - the number of players in the game, used to filter out invalid offer cards
      players - the list of active Player instances to map the saved nicknames to actual objects
      Returns:
      the restored OfferCardTrack matching the snapshot state
